name: eplus-verification
description: EPLUS verification tooling for Claude Cowork: test suites that prove the production plugins behave on a seat. Enabled on testing profiles only.

plugins.name: eplus-hook-verification
plugins.description: On-demand test suite for every hook in every installed EPLUS plugin. /eplus-hook-verification:verify-hooks replays each wiring against fixtures and expectations on the Windows host and writes the results into the session folder the export zips. Testing profiles only: its trigger hooks cost one PowerShell start per prompt and per Glob call.

plugins.name: eplus-acceptance
plugins.description: Live acceptance suite: /eplus-acceptance:run has the model exercise every installed EPLUS plugin in this Cowork session (identity note, failure nudge, main-thread and subagent reports, routing workers, RFI read and researcher echo, presence checks) and write a verdict report with evidence into the session export. No hooks; costs nothing while idle.
